_README: ESTIMATED prices. Edit this file freely — the server reloads it whenever its mtime changes,
and every cost the API returns is labelled estimated:true.
Units: US dollars per 1,000,000 tokens.
input        - uncached prompt tokens (usage.input_tokens)
output       - generated tokens (usage.output_tokens)
cacheRead    - prompt-cache hits (usage.cache_read_input_tokens), ~0.1x input
cacheWrite5m - cache writes with the default 5-minute TTL, ~1.25x input
cacheWrite1h - cache writes with the 1-hour TTL, ~2x input
Claude Code writes 1-hour cache entries, so cacheWrite1h is the rate that
actually dominates these transcripts. Cache reads are ~10x cheaper than input
and vastly outnumber it — never add the four buckets together.
'<synthetic>' is Claude Code's local placeholder model (interrupts, API-error
notices). It never hits the API and always reports zero tokens, so it is priced
at zero rather than reported as unpriced.
A model missing from this table is reported with cost null and listed in
unpricedModels; its tokens are still counted.
codexModels prices the Codex rollouts under ~/.codex/sessions. Its token
accounting has DIFFERENT SEMANTICS to Claude's, so it gets its own table
rather than being forced into the one above:
input        - TOTAL prompt tokens, CACHE-INCLUSIVE (verified: cached_input_tokens
<= input_tokens in all 136 rollouts on this machine). Only the
uncached remainder (input - cachedInput) is charged at this rate.
cachedInput  - the cached share of input, charged at this rate instead.
Codex's analogue of Claude's cacheRead.
output       - generated tokens, INCLUDING reasoning tokens.
reasoningOutput - null ON PURPOSE, and it must stay null. Verified on all 136
rollouts: reasoning_output_tokens <= output_tokens, and
input_tokens + output_tokens == total_tokens exactly. Reasoning
tokens are therefore ALREADY INSIDE output and billed at the
output rate. Giving this a number would charge them twice and
silently inflate the estimate. It is reported as a separate
FIGURE (so you can see how much of the output was reasoning)
but never as a separate CHARGE.
There is no cache-write bucket: Codex does not report one.
codexRatesArePlaceholders: TRUE. Unlike the Claude rates above, these are NOT
taken from a published rate card — no list price for these model ids was
available when this file was written. They are order-of-magnitude placeholders
so the dashboard can show a shape rather than a blank, and every Codex cost the
API returns carries placeholder:true so the UI can say so. Replace them with
real numbers before trusting any Codex figure.
'_default' prices any Codex model not named explicitly.
source: platform.claude.com pricing as cached by the claude-api skill on 2026-08-12; cache multipliers 0.1x read / 1.25x 5m write / 2x 1h write
